servicesGrid.title: Everything your business needs for financial health
servicesGrid.description: From incorporation to your annual audit — one team, accountable for every financial, tax, and insurance process along the way.

items.title: Accounting & Bookkeeping
items.description: Standardized chart of accounts, disciplined daily entries, and precise periodic reports — so you always know exactly where your business stands financially.

items.title: Tax Advisory
items.description: Accurate tax return filing, representation before tax tribunals, and legitimate planning to reduce your tax burden and avoid penalties.

items.title: E-Invoicing & VAT
items.description: Registration, compliant e-invoice issuance, and full alignment with Iran's taxpayer e-invoicing system — without the constant fear of fines.

items.title: Payroll & Social Insurance
items.description: Precise payroll calculations, monthly social security filings, and settlement clearances — on time, every month, without errors.

items.title: Audit & Internal Controls
items.description: Audit reports banks and tax authorities accept, paired with the internal controls your business needs to grow sustainably.

items.title: Company & Trademark Registration
items.description: From choosing the right company type to the official gazette filing and trademark registration — we manage every legal step of getting your business off the ground.

whyUs.title: The shield we built is here to defend your business
whyUs.description: Malibaan was founded on a simple belief: financial fairness is every business's right. That belief still shapes how we work with every client today.

items.title: Transparency in every report
items.description: No number reaches you unexplained. Every financial report is walked through in plain language — not just handed over as a spreadsheet.

items.title: Professional independence
items.description: Our advice serves your business's long-term interest, not upselling more services — exactly as we've shown in high-stakes tax decisions.

items.title: One dedicated expert, not a support queue
items.description: Every business is assigned one named expert who knows your file from day one through today.

items.title: Defense before tax and insurance authorities
items.description: If an audit or dispute comes up, our team stands with you before the review boards and defends your case.
